1879064154.name: Command Respect
1879064154.desc: Your presence commands respect from those around you.

1879073754.name: Throat Rip
1879073754.desc:
You sink your teeth in and rip, and your target is silenced. 
 
 <rgb=#FF7700> In Flayer:Muscle Tear 
 Decreases target movement speed and increases attack duration. </rgb>

1879149914.name: Improved Blinding Flash
1879149914.desc: A flash instantly dazes the enemy, but damage will break its stupor.

1879213914.name: Exposed (Ranged)
1879213914.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879243994.name: Rider and Steed
1879243994.desc: You forge a stronger bond between you and your steed. Surrounding allies also form a stronger bond with their steed.

1879246042.name: Improved Shield-swipe
1879246042.desc: After successfully blocking an enemy's blow, you may attack with both your weapon and shield. This skill draws the enemy's attention to yourself.

1879264218.name: Motivation
1879264218.desc: The Captain is able to rally the fellowship and have them prepared to defeat any foe who may get in their way

1879302618.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Squire)
1879302618.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879315034.name: Pony of Bounty
1879315034.desc: A pony from the Farmers Faire.

1879316058.name: Ferocious Roar
1879316058.desc: Unleash a mighty roar that generates a large amount of Wrath. Applies a slow to the target.

1879339354.name: Dusk-wing Kite
1879339354.desc: Brings out a dusk-wing kite for you to fly!

1879391450.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Squire)
1879391450.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879405402.name: White-headed Hawk
1879405402.desc: Summons a hawk to keep you company.

1879470554.name: Aggressive Strike
1879470554.desc:
Strike recklessly at your opponent.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Finishers are more likely to critically hit.
 </rgb><rgb=#FF0000>Cut-over deals more damage.</rgb>

1879488730.name: Minor Call - Flank
1879488730.desc: Call upon beasts of the wild to surprise your foe, applying the Flanked effect.

1879493466.name: Windfell Owl
1879493466.desc: Summons a majestic owl to accompany you on your adventures.

1879497690.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497690.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.
